trade.ath_note: ATH is the max high across fetched GeckoTerminal daily candles (up to the configured limit) and hourly candles. When the free endpoint returns a shorter window, this is not a lifetime ATH. The backtest seeds its running high with daily highs that printed before the first hourly bar only.
